hook: Telescope mirrors can turn solar dark photons into X-rays, and BabyIAXO could catch them.
summary: Longitudinal solar dark photons, the dominant type below about 1 eV, were missed by past searches. Using Maxwell's equations at a boundary, the author shows they produce light when they hit a grazing-incidence mirror. BabyIAXO would match the XENON1T limits and IAXO would go deeper, but only if sensitivity reaches 10 eV; this is a forecast, not a measurement.
title: Long(itudinal) live the helioscope: novel bounds on solar dark photons from conversion on reflecting surfaces
